basis: Anthocyanidin reductase of proanthocyanidin (PA) synthesis; BAN promoter active only in the endothelium of the testa (Debeaujon et al. 2003 Plant Cell). Top DE in Martin 2026 ii1 clusters (3/5/7 DAP) and Rombi 2026 c7 (pct 1.00 vs 0.05). Also in pigment strand and micropylar endothelium (same PA program).

MATE transporter for vacuolar PA import in the endothelium (Debeaujon et al. 2001 Plant Cell). Martin 2026 ii1-basal top-15 (3/5 DAP); Rombi 2026 c7 0.47/0.02 and pigment strand c15. Raised for two-study agreement.

Dihydroflavonol reductase of the PA/anthocyanin pathway; in the seed confined to PA-accumulating endothelium. Martin 2026 ii1 top-15 (3/7 DAP); Rombi 2026 c7 1.00/0.05. Also anthocyanin-producing vegetative cells, so seed context only.
Leucoanthocyanidin dioxygenase of PA synthesis. Martin 2026 ii1 top-15 (3/7 DAP); Rombi 2026 c7 0.91/0.03. Seed context only (anthocyanin genes elsewhere).
Glutathione S-transferase needed for PA/anthocyanin accumulation. Martin 2026 ii1-basal rank 1-4 at 3/5/7 DAP; Rombi 2026 c7 0.82/0.03.

WIP zinc-finger TF required for endothelium differentiation (Sagasser et al. 2002 Genes Dev; endothelium-only per Debeaujon 2003). Label gene of Martin 2026 "ii1 endothelium (BAN and TT1)"; Rombi 2026 micropylar endothelium c14 0.30/0.01 and c7 0.16/0.01. Low detection.
Sugar transporter; endothelium by MERFISH (Rombi 2026 Fig 1c,d; c7 0.31/0.01, chalazal c15 0.48/0.02) and in Martin 2026 5 DAP ii1 endothelium top-15. Validated in one, cluster-specific in another.

Cytochrome P450 fatty-acid hydroxylase (cutin). Martin 2026 3 DAP ii1 endothelium rank 6; Rombi 2026 micropylar endothelium c14 0.82/0.05 and c7 0.75/0.03. Raised low->medium for two-study agreement (no in situ).
Uncharacterized (GMC oxidoreductase family). Rank 1 in Martin 2026 ii1 endothelium at 3 and 5 DAP; Rombi 2026 c7 0.73/0.02. Two independent atlases agree; not validated.

Hexose SWEET localized to the chalazal pigment strand (Lu et al. 2020 Plant Physiol, cited in Martin 2026 Supp Table 1). Label gene of Martin 2026 "ii1 basal (contains pigment strand)", which merges ii1 with the strand; not in Rombi 2026 Table S3.

Uncharacterized. Martin 2026 ii1-basal/pigment-strand cluster top-15 (5/7 DAP); Rombi 2026 pigment strand c15 0.75/0.02. Use with PA genes (BAN, TT12) plus ARR22 to separate the strand from the rest of the endothelium.
Auxin efflux carrier in funiculus, ii1 and oi1 (Liu et al. 2023 Plant J). Rombi 2026 c15 0.39/0.04 but also ii1-prime c3; Martin 2026 uses it for an oi1 subcluster. Multi-layer: weak alone.

HD-ZIP needed for mucilage secretory cell differentiation of the seed-coat epidermis (Windsor et al. 2000 Plant J; Western et al. 2004 Plant Physiol). Martin 2026 oi2 general label/top-15 (5 DAP); Rombi 2026 c9 0.26/0.02 (also pigment strand c15 0.44/0.02). Also atrichoblast/trichome gene outside the seed.

L1/epidermal-identity HD-ZIP; oi2 by MERFISH (Rombi 2026 Fig 1c,d; c9 0.36/0.02) and Martin 2026 oi2 general top-15 (5 DAP). Conflict: also the embryo protoderm marker (Liew 2024, Lee 2025); in whole-seed data separate with GL2/LTPG6 (oi2) vs PDF1/ABCG15 (embryo).

GPI-anchored lipid transfer protein (cuticular lipid export). Martin 2026 oi2 clusters rank 3-10 (3/5 DAP); Rombi 2026 c9 0.88/0.04. Weak in embryo epidermis (Liew 2024 cl10 0.19/0.02). Raised low->medium for two-study agreement.

GDSL esterase/lipase (uncharacterized). Rank 1-4 in Martin 2026 oi2 clusters (3/5 DAP); Rombi 2026 c9 0.73/0.03. Also in embryo/seedling epidermis (Liew 2024 cl6 0.57/0.07; Lee 2025 1.25 d cl7 0.40/0.11): pan-epidermal in the seed.
GDSL lipase EXL3 (uncharacterized in seeds). Martin 2026 3 DAP oi2 general rank 7; Rombi 2026 c9 0.30/0.01. Not in embryo epidermis clusters. Two-study agreement, not validated.
VLCFA elongase for cuticular wax. Martin 2026 oi2 VLCFA clusters (3/5 DAP); Rombi 2026 c9 0.18/0.01. Also embryo epidermis (Lee 2025 1.25 d cl7 0.23/0.03): pan-epidermal.
Lipid transfer protein localized to oi2 (Francoz et al. 2016 Sci Rep); Martin 2026 "oi2 LTP-enriched" rank 2 (5 DAP). Also the top embryo epidermis gene at germination (Liew 2024 cl10 rank 1).

Galacturonosyltransferase-like protein required for seed-coat mucilage RG-I (Kong et al. 2013 Plant Physiol, cited in Liew 2024 Supp Table 3). Martin 2026 7 DAP oi2 general rank 6. One single-cell study.
BAHD acyltransferase of cutin synthesis. Rombi 2026 c9 0.47/0.01, but Martin 2026 7 DAP embryo upper protoderm rank 5. Conflict: oi2 vs embryo protoderm.

Nitrate transporter; oi1 by MERFISH (Rombi 2026 Table S1; c1 0.25/0.04, c12 0.32/0.06) and in Martin 2026 oi1 top-15 (3/5 DAP). Would be high by agreement, but Almagro et al. 2008 placed NRT1.6 in silique/funicular vasculature: kept medium.
GA-deactivating P450 expressed in the seed coat (Creff et al. 2015 Nat Commun, oi1 per Martin 2026 Supp Table 1); Martin 2026 oi1 top-15 (5 DAP); Rombi 2026 oi1 c12 0.39/0.10 (also ii1-prime c11).

R2R3-MYB regulator of flavonol synthesis (Stracke et al. 2007). Rank 1-2 in Martin 2026 oi1 clusters at 3/5 DAP (a DE pick, not a published marker) and Rombi 2026 oi1 c1 rank 2 (0.19/0.01). DE-only agreement in two atlases, lineage-specific.
Phosphoethanolamine N-methyltransferase. Martin 2026 oi1 rank 2 (5/7 DAP); Rombi 2026 oi1 c1 0.60/0.03. Two-study agreement (no in situ).
Flavonol synthase; Rombi 2026 oi1 c1 0.28/0.01. Also germinating embryo cortex/endodermis (Liew 2024 cl2 0.35/0.05).

Sucrose efflux transporter for seed filling (Chen et al. 2015 Plant Cell). pSWEET12:SWEET12-GFP in micropylar oi1 (Rombi 2026) and rank 1 of Martin 2026 "oi micropylar" (5 DAP). Conflicts: Li et al. 2024 Plant J place it in the placentochalazal layer early; Rombi scRNA detects it equally in chalazal oi1 (c8). Also Phloem_Parenchyma in arabidopsis_leaf.tsv.
Amino acid transporter family. Martin 2026 3 DAP "oi micropylar" rank 2; Rombi 2026 micropylar oi1 c6 0.53/0.08 (chalazal c8 0.49/0.09). Proximal (hilum-side) oi1.

Type-A response regulator; promoter-GUS restricted to the chalaza (Horak et al. 2008 BMC Plant Biol). Martin 2026 CZSC rank 1-3 at 3/5/7 DAP; Rombi 2026 ULD c19 0.90/0.14, chalazal oi1 c8 0.71/0.11, AZ and pigment strand. Chalaza-wide, not one layer.
Amino acid permease of xylem parenchyma (Okumoto 2002); chalazal seed coat by LCM (Le et al. 2010 PNAS); label gene of Martin 2026 "CZSC general (ARR22, AAP6)" at 3 DAP.

Amino acid exporter for seed loading, expressed at the chalazal seed coat (Muller et al. 2015 Curr Biol). Rombi 2026 ULD by MERFISH (c19 0.40/0.001); Martin 2026 "CZSC placentochalazal phosphate transport" rank 1 (3 DAP).
bZIP TF; pbZIP9:GUS-GFP reporter and MERFISH in the ULD (Rombi 2026 Fig 5a; c19 0.60/0.00); rank 1-2 of Martin 2026 placentochalazal callose clusters at 3/5/7 DAP.
Callose synthase; ULD by MERFISH (Rombi 2026; c19 0.39/0.01); rank 1-2 of Martin 2026 placentochalazal callose clusters at 3/5/7 DAP; chalazal seed coat by LCM (Le 2010).

Sucrose SWEET; HCR in the lower proliferating zone of the chalazal seed coat (Martin 2026 Fig 2f) and rank 9 of Rombi 2026 ULD (c19 0.88/0.00). Martin "placentochalazal" and Rombi "ULD" are the same domain.
Cytokinin oxidase; ULD by MERFISH (Rombi 2026 Table S1; c19 0.54/0.00). One study.
X8-domain protein (uncharacterized); ULD by MERFISH (Rombi 2026 Fig 5a) but Table S1 also lists chalazal oi1; Martin 2026 placentochalazal callose top-15 (5/7 DAP).
Heavy-metal-associated isoprenylated protein. Martin 2026 placentochalazal phosphate-transport rank 2 (3 DAP); Rombi 2026 ULD c19 0.77/0.00.
DUF1666 protein (uncharacterized). Martin 2026 placentochalazal callose rank 5-6 (3/5 DAP); Rombi 2026 ULD c19 0.39/0.00.

Glucosinolate transporter; MERFISH in ULD and abscission zone (Rombi 2026). Also a phloem gene in the germinating embryo (Liew 2024 cl15 0.71/0.04; Lee 2025 cl15): marks the phloem terminus, not a seed-coat type.

Argonaute; promoter active in the chalazal seed integument/nucellus (Jullien et al. 2020 Plant J); HCR in the persistent nucellus (Martin 2026 Fig 2c, rank 1 at 3/5 DAP); Rombi 2026 nucellus c18 0.92/0.00. Lost by 7 DAP.
Uncharacterized. Martin 2026 persistent nucellus rank 11 (3/5 DAP); Rombi 2026 c18 0.67/0.00.
Uncharacterized. Martin 2026 persistent nucellus rank 6/14; Rombi 2026 c18 0.63/0.00.
DUF833 protein (uncharacterized). Martin 2026 persistent nucellus rank 4-5; Rombi 2026 c18 0.82/0.01.
Pectate lyase-like; transient nucellus/chalazal proliferating tissue (Xu et al. 2024 bioRxiv, per Martin 2026 Supp Table 1); Martin 2026 3 DAP "CPT transient nucellus" label.

Polygalacturonase required for seed abscission/dehiscence (Ogawa et al. 2009 Plant Cell; hilum per Ferreira et al. 2024 BMC Plant Biol). Rombi 2026 AZ c17 0.21/0.001 (log2FC 8.8); Martin 2026 "FUN hilum (ADPG1)" (3 DAP) and FUN epidermal rank 8 (5 DAP).
Amino acid exporter; AZ by MERFISH (Rombi 2026 Fig 6a; c17 0.48/0.006). Martin 2026 5 DAP "oi micropylar" rank 4 (the micropylar oi abuts the hilum). AGI from paper/NCBI; UniProt lacks the symbol.
Sucrose/H+ symporter; AZ by MERFISH (Rombi 2026 Table S1; c17 0.15/0.00). One study.
Receptor kinase required for floral organ abscission (Jinn et al. 2000 Genes Dev); Rombi 2026 c17 0.18/0.01. Function shown only in floral AZ.
Floral AZ MYB (Wen et al. 2025, per Rombi 2026); c17 0.29/0.01. One study.
Amino acid transporter; ii1-prime by MERFISH (Rombi 2026 Table S1; c11 0.75/0.09, c3 0.49/0.08) and rank 1 of Martin 2026 5 DAP ii1-prime. UniProt has no symbol; AGI from the papers.
Amino acid transporter localized to ii1-prime (Muller 2016 thesis, per Martin 2026 Supp Table 1); MERFISH ii1-prime (Rombi 2026; c11 0.83/0.13); Martin 2026 ii1-prime top-15 (5 DAP).

Amino acid transporter; ii1-prime by MERFISH (Rombi 2026; c11 0.84/0.15). Conflict: Martin 2026 has it in micropylar endosperm (5 DAP rank 3, 7 DAP ESR), and earlier work places UMAMIT25 in endosperm.

Vacuolar processing enzyme driving PCD of inner-integument layers (Nakaune et al. 2005 Plant Cell). Martin 2026 ii2 general and 7 DAP ii1-prime/ii2 rank 1; broad in Rombi 2026 (pct2 0.82). Marks ii2 and ii1-prime together.
O-fucosyltransferase family. Rank 1-2 of Martin 2026 ii2 general (3/5 DAP); Rombi 2026 ii2 c10 0.27/0.07 and c0 0.23/0.06. The only ii2-specific agreement found.
Subtilase. Rank 1-2 of Martin 2026 ii2 general (3/5 DAP); Rombi 2026 ii2 c10 0.24/0.07.

Type I MADS factor expressed only in the syncytial endosperm; suppresses cellularization (Kang et al. 2008 Plant Cell; Roszak 2011 PNAS). Label gene of Martin 2026 PEN general (3 DAP). Stage-restricted (pre-cellularization).

Alpha-expansin of the germinating endosperm (Sanchez-Montesino et al. 2019 Mol Plant, cited in Liew 2024 Supp Table 3 under the swapped ID AT3G03450). Lee 2025 1.25 d cl6 (published "Seed coat") 0.32/0.04: supports reading that cluster as endosperm. Germination stage only.
Sucrose transporter expressed in endosperm (Baud et al. 2005 Plant J). Rombi 2026 c13 (embryo+endosperm) 0.36/0.03 but also micropylar endothelium c14 0.41/0.03.
bHLH95 expressed only in the embryo-surrounding region, required for endosperm breakdown (Yang et al. 2008 Development). Martin 2026 7 DAP MCE_ESR rank 7; Rombi 2026 c13 0.14/0.00 (log2FC 8.8).
Subtilase of the ESR required for embryo cuticle formation (Tanaka et al. 2001 Development). Martin 2026 5 DAP MCE rank 5 and 7 DAP ESR rank 6.
KERBEROS, ESR-specific, needed for the embryo sheath (Moussu et al. 2017 Plant Cell). Label gene of Martin 2026 7 DAP ESR cluster.
Reversibly glycosylated polypeptide expressed in the ESR (Fourquin et al. 2016 Development). Rank 1 of Martin 2026 5 DAP MCE and 7 DAP ESR sheath clusters.
GDSL lipase; HCR in the 7 DAP ESR (Martin 2026 ED Fig 6c); rank 9 in ESR clusters. One study.
Auxin response factor expressed in micropylar endosperm (Rademacher et al. 2011 Plant J); label of Martin 2026 3 DAP MCE cluster.
IQ-domain protein; Martin 2026 PEN top-15 at 5 and 7 DAP; endosperm by LCM (Le 2010). No validated PEN-specific marker exists.
RALF-like peptide; HCR in the basal chalazal cyst (Martin 2026 Fig 4c); rank 2 of 3 DAP CZE basal cyst (nuclei assigned by hand on RALFL3).
Uncharacterized; HCR in the apical chalazal cyst/nodules (Martin 2026 Fig 4c); rank 4 of 3 DAP CZE nodule.
Uncharacterized; CZE cyst marker in Picard et al. 2021 Nat Plants snRNA and Martin 2026 5 DAP apical cyst rank 6 (independent studies, not validated).
HD-ZIP IV; chalazal cyst (Nakamura et al. 2006 Plant Physiol); Martin 2026 CZE nodule rank 2 (5 DAP).
Chalazal cyst by LCM (Le et al. 2010 PNAS); Martin 2026 5 DAP apical cyst label (rank 14).
D-type cyclin in chalazal nodules (Picard 2021 snRNA); label of Martin 2026 CZE nodule (3/5 DAP), not in its top-15.
Basal-lineage WOX TF of the suspensor (Ueda et al. 2011 Dev Cell). Detected in only 31 Martin 2026 nuclei; suspensor nuclei were assigned by a module-score threshold. Pre-heart stages only.
Auxin efflux carrier of the suspensor/basal lineage; label of Martin 2026 3 DAP suspensor (not in its top-15).
Apical-lineage WOX of the proembryo; rank 2 of Martin 2026 3 DAP embryo upper protoderm. Early globular stage only.
L1-identity HD-ZIP (protoderm and epidermis). Liew 2024 cl6 0.52/0.06; Lee 2025 1.25 d cl7 0.28/0.08. In whole seeds also oi2 (Rombi 2026 MERFISH): use ABCG15/PDF1 to keep embryo epidermis apart.
L1-specific protodermal factor; HCR in the embryo protoderm (Martin 2026 Fig 1h; rank 1-3 of protoderm clusters at 5/7 DAP) and Liew 2024 epidermis cl6 0.77/0.15.
Epidermis-specific VLCFA elongase (Yephremov 1999). Lee 2025 1.25 d cl7 0.64/0.19; Liew 2024 cl6 0.73/0.09; Martin 2026 7 DAP protoderm rank 9 (and 5 DAP oi2 rank 5).
Epidermis-expressed lipid transfer protein. Rank 1 of Liew 2024 cl10 (0.53/0.14) and Lee 2025 1.25 d cl4 0.41/0.23. Also seed-coat oi2 (Martin 2026).

ABC half-transporter. In every Martin 2026 embryo protoderm cluster (rank 1-10, 3/5/7 DAP), Liew 2024 cl6 0.45/0.04 and Lee 2025 1.25 d cl4/cl7 (0.27/0.07). Not in seed-coat clusters: separates embryo epidermis from oi2.
YABBY TF of abaxial lateral-organ identity (all layers, not epidermis only). Lee 2025 1.25 d cl4 0.17/0.06 ("abaxial leaf primordia"); Martin 2026 lists it for the upper protoderm (Capron 2009).
GRAS TF of endodermis/ground-tissue initials and QC (Wysocka-Diller et al. 2000 Development). Martin 2026 7 DAP ground tissue initials top-15. Not DE in Liew 2024.
C2H2 TF of ground tissue initials (Welch et al. 2007 Genes Dev). Rank 2 of Martin 2026 cortical initials at 5 and 7 DAP.

Uncharacterized; cortex/endodermis precursor marker (Dorrity 2021). Rank 1 of Martin 2026 7 DAP cortical initials; Liew 2024 cl2 0.37/0.04; Lee 2025 1.25 d cl1 0.30/0.10. Three-study agreement, not validated.
GA 3-oxidase; in situ in cortex and endodermis of the germinating embryo axis (Yamaguchi et al. 1998 Plant Cell). Rank 1 of Lee 2025 1.25 d cl1, published as "Root stele" (label conflict).
Plastid protein (ycf33-like; called CLTM in Liew 2024); in situ in hypocotyl cortex at 12-24 h (Liew 2024 Fig 4b), cl7 0.92/0.22, but also cotyledon mesophyll.
HD-ZIP III of procambium (Baima et al. 1995; Scarpella 2004). Lee 2025 1.25 d vascular cl8 0.14/0.02; Martin 2026 7 DAP vascular primordium top-15. Low detection.

GRAS TF transcribed in provasculature/stele (Helariutta et al. 2000 Cell). Martin 2026 7 DAP vascular primordium rank 6; also Rombi 2026 maternal ULD 0.32/0.00 (vascular terminus). Skill root table files it under Stele.
RanBP2 zinc-finger protein (JULGI); HCR in the embryo vascular primordium (Martin 2026 Fig 1h) and in Lee 2025 1.25 d vascular cl8 (0.12/0.04, weak).
bHLH of provascular/xylem-precursor cells (Schlereth et al. 2010 Nature). Liew 2024 cl12 0.21/0.03 and protoxylem cl9 0.41/0.04.
Xylogen-like arabinogalactan protein of vascular cells (Motose et al. 2004). Lee 2025 1.25 d vascular cl8 0.20/0.04; Liew 2024 cl12 0.36/0.03. Raised for two-study agreement.
TDIF receptor of procambium. Lee 2025 1.25 d cl8 0.10/0.01; Rombi 2026 maternal ULD 0.20/0.00.
Xylem cysteine protease of tracheary-element autolysis (Funk 2002). Liew 2024 protoxylem cl9 0.77/0.01; Lee 2025 0 d xylem cl15 top-20.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase. Liew 2024 cl9 0.43/0.01; Lee 2025 0 d xylem cl15 rank 12.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase. Rank 1 of Lee 2025 0 d xylem cl15; Liew 2024 cl9 0.49/0.00.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase. Lee 2025 0 d cl15 rank 4; Liew 2024 cl9 0.63/0.00.
Master regulator of secondary-wall synthesis. Liew 2024 cl9 0.45/0.00.
NAC master switch of metaxylem vessel differentiation (Kubo 2005). Liew 2024 cl9 0.38/0.00; Lee 2025 0 d cl15.
VND-family NAC of vessel differentiation. Liew 2024 cl9 0.53/0.01; Lee 2025 0 d cl15; also Rombi 2026 abscission zone c17 0.12/0.00.
Dirigent protein; in situ in protoxylem at 48 h (Liew 2024 Fig 3a), cl9 0.87/0.14, but also provascular cl12 0.60/0.11 and Lee 2025 vascular cl8: marks provasculature plus protoxylem.
MYB TF required for phloem (SE and CC) identity (Bonke 2003). Liew 2024 protophloem cl15 0.76/0.01; Lee 2025 1.25 d phloem cl15 0.35/0.01.
Late-protophloem enhancer-trap gene (Bauby et al. 2007 Plant Cell Physiol). Liew 2024 cl15 0.49/0.01; Lee 2025 1.25 d cl15 0.23/0.01.
Companion-cell sucrose/H+ symporter for phloem loading (Stadler 1996; Truernit & Sauer 1995). Martin 2026 funicular companion cells rank 2; Liew 2024 cl15 0.78/0.04; Lee 2025 cl15 0.57/0.02.
Plasma-membrane H+-ATPase with companion-cell promoter activity (DeWitt & Sussman 1995). Liew 2024 cl15 0.91/0.01; Lee 2025 cl15 0.77/0.03.
Heavy-metal-binding protein expressed in companion cells, needed for phloem transport (Tian et al. 2010 Plant Cell). Liew 2024 cl15 0.73/0.01; Lee 2025 1.25 d cl15 0.40/0.01.
Phloem lectin with companion-cell promoter activity (Dinant et al. 2003 Plant Physiol). Martin 2026 funicular companion cells rank 5; Liew 2024 cl15 0.56/0.01; Lee 2025 cl15 0.19/0.00.
NAC TF of root-cap (columella and LRC) identity (Willemsen et al. 2008 Dev Cell). Martin 2026 7 DAP "hypophysis" rank 3; Liew 2024 radicle tip cl14 0.17/0.009.
NAC TF of root-cap maturation (Bennett et al. 2010 Plant Cell). Liew 2024 cl14 0.20/0.002.
Root growth factor peptide; QC/columella scRNA marker (Denyer 2019). Martin 2026 7 DAP hypophysis rank 9; Liew 2024 cl4 0.29/0.01.
AP2 TF of the root stem-cell niche. Martin 2026 7 DAP hypophysis rank 4; Liew 2024 cl4 0.14/0.00 (weak).
AP2 TF of the root stem-cell niche. Liew 2024 cl4 0.14/0.005 (weak); Martin 2026 3 DAP suspensor rank 7 (basal embryo).
Light-harvesting complex protein; Curio cotyledon region (Lee 2025 ED Fig 2i); Liew 2024 cl13 0.85/0.19; Lee 2025 cl2/cl11. Also green embryo cells in Rombi 2026 c13. Greening cotyledons only.
Rubisco small subunit; Liew 2024 cl13 0.95/0.29; Lee 2025 cl11 0.98/0.44. Broad in all green cells (cortex too).
Beta-xylosidase; HCR in inner (ground) cells of the 7 DAP cotyledons (Martin 2026 Fig 1h, one experiment), rank 4 of that cluster. Pre-mesophyll of the embryo.
APC/C activator of G2/M. Lee 2025 1.25 d cl13 rank 1, 0 d cl12 rank 2; Martin 2026 3 DAP PEN G2/M rank 2. MERFISH in seedling (Lee 2025 ED Fig 3d).
DNA topoisomerase II of proliferating cells. Martin 2026 PEN/EMB G2M clusters (rank 2/5); Lee 2025 cl13 0.34/0.07 and 0 d cl12. MERFISH in seedling (Lee 2025).
HMG-box protein used as S-phase marker (Denyer 2024). Martin 2026 S-phase clusters of EMB, PEN, oi1 and oi2; Rombi 2026 "cell state" c16 0.32/0.03.
Ribonucleotide reductase small subunit, S-phase induced (Wang & Liu 2006 Plant Cell). Martin 2026 oi1 S-phase rank 6; Rombi 2026 c16 0.29/0.06.
Oleosin; in situ across the whole 12 h embryo (Liew 2024 Fig 5c), cl8 0.92/0.26; Lee 2025 1.25 d cl14. Storage/maturation program in every embryo cell, not a type.
Late-embryogenesis-abundant protein. Lee 2025 1.25 d cl14 (published "Embryo radicle") 0.36/0.01. Residual maturation program.
12S cruciferin storage protein. Martin 2026 7 DAP inner cotyledon rank 7; Lee 2025 cl14 0.22/0.02; Liew 2024 cl8.
Bifunctional nuclease of developmental PCD (Van Durme 2023 PNAS). Martin 2026 unfertilized-ovule cluster rank 12 and 7 DAP ESR high-PCD rank 1. Marks dying cells (ovules, ESR, integuments).
